religion_ritual.note: `போகுபலி வெண்சோறு` is retained as source offering language only; no later ritual system is imposed.

textual_intertextual_relationships.note: The printed alternate poet reading `உறையூர் முது கூற்றனார் எனவும் பாடம்` is preserved as a textual attribution variant, not normalized away.

communities_social_groups.note: `மறவன்` is preserved exactly as source martial/social terminology; no later identity equivalence is imposed.

food_subsistence.note: Only surviving food/hunting wording is classified; the lacunose monitor-lizard passage is not reconstructed.

textual_intertextual_relationships.note: Printed `பாடியவர்: பெயர் தெரிந்திலது` records unknown attribution; lacunose text is not used to invent a name.

empty_notes.named_entities: The poet is explicitly unknown; `பெயர் தெரிந்திலது` is not a named entity.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: Only surviving adornment wording around `பொலம் ...` is retained; missing text is not reconstructed.

empty_notes.textual_intertextual_relationships: The record is incomplete/lacunose, but no separate printed textual/classification variant is supplied; missing text is not reconstructed.

flora.note: Only surviving source plant names (`குருந்து`, `முல்லை`, `வரகு`, `தினை`, `கொள்ளு`, `அவரை`) are retained; the lacuna is not used to reconstruct missing flowers.

communities_social_groups.note: `துடியன், பாணன், பறையன், கடம்பன்` are preserved exactly as the poem's source group terms; no later caste/community equivalence is imposed.

religion_ritual.note: `கல்லே பரவின் ... நெல்உகுத்துப் பரவும் கடவுளும் இலவே` is retained as this poem's own memorial-worship/deity language; it is not generalized into a historical claim that other gods or religions were absent.

death_mourning_memory.note: The fallen fighter and worshipped memorial stone are explicit death/memory evidence.

arts_music_performance.note: `துடியன்`, `பாணன்`, `பறையன்` are explicit source performance-role terms retained literally.

empty_notes.textual_intertextual_relationships: The record is incomplete/lacunose; no separate printed textual/classification variant is supplied, and missing text is not reconstructed.
